sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 28 points from 12 games, face a trip to Bilston Town on Saturday 17 October at 15:00. Sandbach are in outstanding league form, winning four of their last five matches (with one draw), and come up against a Bilston side sitting third with 23 points who themselves are on an excellent run of five consecutive wins. This represents a significant test for the division's pacesetters.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (24 points) host Brereton Social at 15:00 on Saturday, looking to bounce back after a recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth travel to Barnton in a match between two strong contenders—Barnton sit sixth having won four straight league matches, while seventh-place AFC Bridgnorth remain unbeaten in their last four. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Telford Town at 15:00; Wolves are fifth and in good recent form, whilst Telford sit bottom with just 7 points and offer little resistance. The midtable clash sees Allscott Heath host Foley Meir (both on 12 points), while Crewe entertain Eccleshall—Eccleshall are sixth and performing solidly, whereas Crewe have won just once in seven games. New Mills face Alsager Town, the division's basement dwellers with only 4 points and six consecutive defeats. Shawbury United host Cheadle Heath Nomads in a low-table encounter, Wednesfield Community travel to Market Drayton Town, and Widnes Town face Dawley Town on Saturday. The midweek fixture sees Bilston Town host Dawley Town on Wednesday 14 October at 19:45.
